naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 4→2: report.tex:320–324 gives Cd0.0617/Cl9.2e−5 and delivered PDF pp5–7 contains residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Last 308 force rows Cd0.072724→0.061706 (15.2% decrease, range0.059928–0.072724), inconsistent with a settled steady force despite reported 4 residual orders; low-Mach drag is also large. Exact production source remains unbound; no CFD rerun.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: NACA0012 M0.80 inviscid: report.tex:402–404 gives Cd=0.050 but no numeric Cl summary found; residual history f679644:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_residuals.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:375); force history f679644:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_forces.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:382); computed-field contour f679644:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_mach.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:389). Score capped at 2 from 4 because the immutable contestant report is missing one or more required post-processing classes; raw result/workspace artifacts or evaluator redraws do not satisfy this report-deliverable floor. Earlier case note, now limited by this floor: Validator-valid, near-zero lift and np8 comparison.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 4→2: report.tex:361–364 gives Cd0.583/Cl−0.0011 and delivered PDF pp7–9 includes histories and Mach/pressure fields; last 230 Cd0.590864→0.582827. cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2→1: selected metadata marks statistically periodic to t=300, but all 10001 rows t>=200 have identical Cd4.8532587021 and Cl−0.0023802775736; no credible shedding or St. f679644 report has no Re200 numeric summary, plots or wake contours; report.tex:511–514 says cylinder cases did not complete. Metadata timestamps fixed 2024 and revision null, so exact run/source binding remains unresolved. No CFD rerun.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Selected solver/results/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200/metadata.json says completed=true, statistically_periodic, t=300 but the entire submitted t=200–300 force window has exactly constant Cd=4.8532587021 and Cl=−0.0023802775736; no late shedding is shown. M2 laminar metadata says converged, but last 65 Cd rows decrease 3.9742929239→3.1464435562 (20.8%); report.tex:511–514 and run_manifest.csv mark this case incomplete/not converged. Generation relation between report and workspace results is not established. No CFD rerun.

flags.flag: Full mesh or full state replicated on all MPI ranks during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable f679644:solver/src/main.cpp:179–181 reads GlobalMesh on every rank; :192–199 partitions and constructs local mesh without releasing it; :211–229 invokes solver.run() in the same scope while global_mesh remains alive. TASK.md prohibited shortcut 7 prohibits full-mesh replication during iterations. METIS and neighbor halos are real, so this is not numbered DQ9’s narrower full-state/geometric-split condition. Selected metadata revision is null, so exact source/result binding remains uncertain.

limitations: No rerun; Re200 was not rerun.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
